title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for the frequency of radial oscillation.

title: Equations of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly write the equations of motion for the mass in polar coordinates.

title: Centripetal Force
description: Important Criteria: The student must relate the centripetal force to the spring force using the correct expressions.

title: Radial Impulse Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly analyze the effect of the small radial impulse on the motion.

title: Assumption Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide justification for the assumption that r' is much smaller than R.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the equations of motion or final expression.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms in the equations are dimensionally consistent.
